references.text: Both verses document the same sequence of events in Joseph's story: the arrival in Goshen (Gen 47:1) and later the departure from Goshen at his father's death (Gen 50:8).
Gen 45:10 is the prophetic instruction to settle in Goshen with livestock, while Gen 50:8 shows that this group actually leaves this place at his father's death.
A narrative parallel where Joseph is first sent out alone to check on his brothers (Gen 37:14), while later he leads the whole family on a joint journey (Gen 50:8).
